about_the_game:
Polysouls is an open-world action RPG that challenges gamers with true combat, intelligent decision-making, and a huge, explorable world. The game uses a unique minimalist art style with simple, textures but rich gameplay mechanics.

Influenced by the Soulslike genre but built with its own distinct systems, Polysouls focuses on skillful play and awareness of the environment. Each battle demands accurate timing, strategic movement, and control of the game mechanics to live. Enemies never let up, and the world is full of secrets to be discovered.

Key Features:

Dynamic Combat: A rich and satisfying combat system where every hit, dodge, and parry counts.

Large Open World: Find yourself in a vast world with challenges and hidden areas. Search for secrets, overcome challenges, and forge your own path.

Player-Controlled Gameplay: Customize your gameplay by way of abilities, weapons, and character build.

Minimalist Visual Style: A unique visual style with clean, minimalist textures that enhance immersion and readability.

Difficult Encounters: Strategic and challenging combat with enemies that will test your skills and adaptability.

 

Ready to be the master of Polysouls? Every battle is a learning experience, and every defeat is a stepping stone to greatness. Only those who learn and adapt will survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 (8GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Polysouls is an open-world action RPG with deep, skill-based combat. Every enemy is deadly, every fight a test of patience and precision. Explore massive world full of hidden paths, powerful enemies, and secret places.
